about_the_game:
A wealthy and well-established family will have an economic mishap that will change their lives for the worse.

A catastrophe for some, except for our protagonist, who will use what is coming to his advantage.

In Demon Boy Saga you play as a young college student who lives in a house with beautiful women. When a financial situation occurs, he will use this to find new ways and reasons to get closer to these women and use this excuse to his advantage. And he will go to any lengths necessary to achieve his goals.

The game is an adventure that blends visual novel and sandbox elements, where you will explore different scenarios. The game features day, afternoon, and night time periods, as well as inventory and money options to purchase items.
